target_selection.difficulty_gate: Target separation must exceed max(2*baseline sample SD, 2*largest observed absolute development mesh change, 0.03*baseline mean). No target or extension if none qualifies; report valid feasibility outcome.
target_selection.selection: Among families with 3/3 feasible, select largest positive mean difference supported by same-sign first-seed H2 effect exceeding sum of observed absolute H1/H2 changes; if no upward eligible, largest absolute downward difference. Ties: variant ID ascending.
target_selection.target_hit_tolerance_rule: max(0.02, 2*maximum observed relative development H1/H2 change); tolerance must be less than half relative target-baseline separation, otherwise no target trial
